title: Predicting MCI to AD Conversation Using Integrated sMRI and rs-fMRI: Machine Learning and Graph Theory Approach.
summary: RSFS feature selection paired with graph/MRI measures and machine-learning classifiers distinguished MCI converters from nonconverters and MCI converters from AD in ADNI nested-validation analyses. The reported accuracies are retrospective classification results, not prospective prediction of clinical benefit. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: ADNI imaging, intra-subject MCI converter/nonconverter and inter-subject MCIc/AD classifications; RSFS feature selection and SVM nested cross-validation, compared with alternative selectors/classifiers and upsampling. Results report 84.71% and 89.80% best accuracy and associated brain features.
